<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex8602_202409183" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon"><milestone unit="section" n="Colophon (95a8-95a9)"/>
        <lg><l>sde snod mgnon pa mi'i sde bdun dang ¦</l>
        <l><expan>bye brag</expan> bshad mdzod nying khu lta bu yin |</l> 
        <l><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3761">mngon mdzod</rs> gzhung don bde blag <expan>rtogs</expan> bya'i phyir |</l> 
        <l>rnaM bshad nying khu pa'i 'od 'dra 'di |</l> <l>rang dang gzhan la phan phyir <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:6029"><expan>bdag</expan></rs> <expan>gis</expan> bzhengs |</l> 
        <l><expan>dge gshegs</expan> daM chos 'di dang mi 'bral zhing |</l> 
        <l>'gro ba °° <lb edRef="inst:5282" n="95a9"/> °° |</l> <l>mthug <expan>rnam mkhyen</expan> pa la 'god par shog |</l></lg>
        <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">mkhan chen <expan>pa</expan></rs><expan>'i</expan> phyag dpe 'di |  <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5284">dbyang dpal</rs> gyi legs par bris pa 'di dge zhing <expan>bkra shis</expan> par 'gyur gcig || shub+haM || || ||</seg></TEI>
